optimizedContext.value:
# Open Code Plugin

## Rules

- Named export `create(options: PluginLoaderOptions): AgentPlugin`.
- Factory read `specd-plugin.json`: own dir, then parent; pass `name`, `version`; hardcode `type` as `agent`.
- Domain: runtime `AgentPlugin`, constructor `name`, `version`; `type` getter `agent`; Open Code frontmatter type; skill-name frontmatter map.
- Structured frontmatter only: required `name`, `description`; optional `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata: Record<string, string>`; exclude unknown fields.
- `InstallSkills`: get skills from `@specd/skills`; resolve per-skill frontmatter; capabilities exactly `['mcp', 'agents', 'frontmatter']`; resolve bundles via `ResolveBundle`; pass `variables.sharedFolder` only override.
- Install non-shared: skills `.opencode/skills/<skill-name>/`, agents `.opencode/agents/<agent-name>/`, relative to `projectRoot`; shared: rendered `sharedFolder` below project root. No `agents` capability: agents beside shared context.
- Agent install: YAML `mode: "subagent"`; transform `allowedTools` (`Bash`, `Read`) to permissions (`- bash: allow`, `- read: allow`); prepend rendered system prompt with YAML. Never prepend YAML to resolved standard skills.
- Never call `SkillRepository.getBundle(...)` when `ResolveBundle` exists; never use `buildCapabilities`.
- Rendered local skill markdown: only configured supported fields; shared files no Open Code frontmatter.
- Default `sharedFolder`: relative path from runtime config dir; no `SKILL.md` there.
- `install()`: `injectSpecdBlock(agentsMdPath, prompt)` base prompt into project-root `AGENTS.md`; `removeSpecdBlock(agentsMdPath, "opencode")`; no plugin marker injection.
- `uninstall()`: remove plugin marker then base block; delete only managed skill dirs, agent files, and—unfiltered—sharedFolder. Filters remove only selected assets; retain sharedFolder for filtered skill uninstall; preserve unrelated `.opencode/skills/` and `.opencode/agents/` assets.
- `specd project init` includes `@specd/plugin-agent-opencode`; `@specd/specd` depends on it.
- Default standard skill install includes `specd-fasttrack`; resolve via `ResolveBundle`, supported capabilities, structured frontmatter, existing skill-dir contract; preserve capability workflow branches, supported fields only.

## Constraints

- Depend on `@specd/skills`; implement `AgentPlugin` from `@specd/plugin-manager`.
- Adapter only: no domain logic outside orchestration.
- Factory reads and passes manifest `name`/`version`; never hardcode. `type` remains hardcoded `agent`.
